apps.name: Office
apps.description: Keep documents, canvases, slides and spreadsheets together in one workspace. Connect related work inside a document and use the desktop app with a local workspace, even while offline.

apps.name: Work
apps.description: Open your hosted Gravitas workspace on Android. Pick up the same documents, canvases, slides and spreadsheets you use in the browser, and upload files from your phone. Requires a connection and Gravitas sign-in.
